resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Arabic source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, route checks, and generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Arabic pass identified 25 remaining technical wording, unit-formatting, and terminology defects across TCR, trigonometry, thermal concepts, heat flux, and SI conversions; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Arabic human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The TCR description used the verb يقدر in a way that sounded like estimation rather than definition.
evidence: The previous description began ‘يقدر معامل درجة حرارة المقاومة كيفية تغير المقاومة...’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the clearer technical wording ‘يصف معامل درجة حرارة المقاومة كيفية تغير المقاومة...’.

findings.summary: The linear-model introduction used an awkward literal phrase for the first-order relationship.
evidence: The previous paragraph said ‘استخدم علاقة الدرجة الأولى’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘استخدم العلاقة الخطية من الدرجة الأولى’.

findings.summary: The coefficient-unit explanation spelled out units inconsistently and did not preserve the standard ppm notation.
evidence: The previous bullet used ‘1/درجة مئوية أو جزء في المليون/درجة مئوية’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the compact technical notation ‘1/°C أو ppm/°C’.

findings.summary: The TCR title used feminine agreement that was less natural for the technical values being discussed.
evidence: The previous title was ‘TCR الإيجابية والسلبية’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘قيم TCR الموجبة والسالبة’.

findings.summary: The positive-TCR bullet used an awkward verbal construction.
evidence: The previous bullet began ‘يعني TCR الإيجابي زيادة المقاومة...’.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as ‘تؤدي قيمة TCR موجبة إلى زيادة المقاومة...’.

findings.summary: The TCR example setup contained a corrupted degree unit and an unclear coefficient unit.
evidence: The previous setup used ‘20 درجة مئوية’ and ‘400 جزء في المليون / 0 درجة مئوية’.
findings.resolution: Replaced it with protected units: ‘20 °C’ and ‘400 ppm/°C’.

findings.summary: The trigonometry title translated sides as الجوانب rather than the geometric term الأضلاع.
evidence: The previous title was ‘إيجاد الجوانب والزوايا المجهولة’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘إيجاد الأضلاع والزوايا المجهولة’.

findings.summary: The worked-example title used an imperative phrase rather than a concise example label.
evidence: The previous title was ‘ابحث عن جانب’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘إيجاد ضلع’.

findings.summary: The waveform variable definition used الوقت instead of the more precise technical term الزمن.
evidence: The previous bullet described t as ‘الوقت بالثواني’.
findings.resolution: Changed the definition to use ‘الزمن بالثواني’.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity unit definition used the colloquial بـ construction.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘C هي السعة الحرارية بـ J/K أو J/°C’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the clearer unit phrase ‘بوحدة J/K أو J/°C’.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity setup spelled out measurement units instead of retaining the standard protected symbols.
evidence: The previous setup used kilogram and درجة مئوية in prose.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the compact engineering form ‘0.20 kg ... 20 °C ... 70 °C’.

findings.summary: The electrical-heating title used التدفئة, which is less suitable for the technical process described.
evidence: The previous title was ‘التدفئة بالطاقة الكهربائية’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘التسخين بالطاقة الكهربائية’.

findings.summary: The heating setup localized protected energy and power units inconsistently.
evidence: The previous setup used كيلوجول and واط in prose.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘41.8 kJ’ and ‘100 W’ while retaining the loss-free condition.

findings.summary: The object/material title used the literal word كائن rather than the engineering term الجسم.
evidence: The previous title was ‘كائن مقابل المادة’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the natural technical title ‘الجسم والمادة’.

findings.summary: The phase-change title used a literal translation of phase as المرحلة.
evidence: The previous title was ‘تغييرات المرحلة والحدود العملية’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the technical phrase ‘تغيرات الطور والحدود العملية’.

findings.summary: The phase-change explanation used a less precise phrase for specific latent heat.
evidence: The previous sentence ended ‘L هي الحرارة الكامنة المحددة بـ J/kg’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘الحرارة الكامنة النوعية بوحدة J/kg’.

findings.summary: The heat-flux definition called q'' heat flow instead of heat-flux density, obscuring the per-area meaning.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘q'' هو تدفق الحرارة بوحدة W/m²’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘q'' هي كثافة التدفق الحراري بوحدة W/m²’.

findings.summary: The heat-flux area definition localized m² inconsistently.
evidence: The previous bullet used ‘بالمتر المربع (م²)’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the consistent protected unit ‘بوحدة m²’.

findings.summary: The conduction bullet used علامة الطرح rather than the clearer term for a negative sign.
evidence: The previous bullet began ‘تشير علامة الطرح...’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘تشير الإشارة السالبة...’.

findings.summary: The convection/radiation paragraph needed smoother Arabic syntax and an explicit absolute-temperature condition.
evidence: The previous paragraph used short repeated sentences and ended with ‘بالكلفن’ without the absolute qualifier.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with connected prose and the explicit requirement that radiation temperatures be absolute and in kelvin.

findings.summary: The SI base-unit title used المشتركة rather than الأساسية.
evidence: The previous title was ‘وحدات SI المشتركة’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the accurate title ‘وحدات SI الأساسية’.

findings.summary: The decimal-prefix example localized mA and A into inconsistent Arabic words and letters.
evidence: The previous paragraph used ‘مللي أمبير’ and ‘أ’ in the conversion equation.
findings.resolution: Changed it to protected engineering units: ‘15 mA’ and ‘0.015 A’.

findings.summary: The inch conversion formula retained the English word inch.
evidence: The previous formula began ‘1 inch = ...’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the Arabic unit name while preserving mm and m symbols: ‘1 بوصة = 25.4 mm = 0.0254 m’.

findings.summary: The pound-to-kilogram conversion localized the protected units into ambiguous Arabic words.
evidence: The previous bullet used ‘1 رطل ≈ ... كجم’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the unambiguous technical notation ‘1 lb ≈ 0.45359237 kg’.

findings.summary: The unit-check bullet was a fragment rather than a direct instruction.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘تحويل قبل الضرب أو القسمة’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the complete imperative ‘حوّل الوحدات قبل الضرب أو القسمة’.
